how.title: From need to done, in four simple steps.

steps.title: Describe your need
steps.body: Tell us what needs doing at your home, garden or office — in a few words or with photos.

steps.title: Get matched
steps.body: Loqelo connects your request with relevant service providers in your area.

steps.title: Receive offers
steps.body: Providers send you their offers, so you can compare price, timing and reviews side by side.

steps.title: Choose your provider
steps.body: Pick the offer that fits you best and get the job done — no endless calls or chasing.

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.body: We use optional analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to understand how many people visit and which countries they come from. No form data is ever shared with analytics.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Loqelo ([TBD legal entity name and address]) is the controller of the personal data collected on loqelo.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you join the waitlist we collect your email address, country, whether you sign up as a customer or a service provider, the optional individual/business type, your language and the time you gave consent.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
sections.body: We use this data only to inform you about the Loqelo launch and important product updates, based on your consent. You can withdraw consent at any time using the unsubscribe link in every email or by contacting us.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: If you accept analytics cookies, we use Google Analytics 4 to measure visits, countries and sign-up conversion. Form contents such as your email address are never sent to analytics. If you decline, no analytics scripts are loaded.

sections.heading: Processors
sections.body: Waitlist contacts are stored with our email provider ([TBD — e.g. Brevo]) and the website is hosted by Vercel. Both act as data processors on our behalf.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, delete or export your data and to lodge a complaint with your data protection authority. Contact us at the email address below.
